Step 1 in the construction is to divide each side into three equal parts, construct an equi- lateral triangle on the middle part, and then delete the middle part (see the ﬁgure). Step 2 is to repeat step 1 for each side of the resulting polygon. This process is repeated at each succeeding step. The snowﬂake curve is the curve that results from repeating this process indeﬁnitely.
